## Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

slide_id = params.slide_id
qc_root = Path(params.qc_dir)
slide_dir = qc_root / slide_id
summary_path = slide_dir / "qc_summary.json"

with open(summary_path) as f:
    summary = json.load(f)

overall = summary.get("overall_status", "unknown")
n_cells = summary.get("n_cells", 0)
n_pass = summary.get("n_cells_qc_pass", 0)
pct_pass = 100 * n_pass / n_cells if n_cells else 0
```

## Executive Summary

```{python}
#| label: exec-summary
rows = []
for mod, block in summary.get("modules", {}).items():
    rows.append({"module": mod, "status": block.get("status", "unknown")})
status_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
display(status_df)

Markdown(f"""
**Slide:** `{slide_id}`  
**Overall status:** `{overall}`  
**Cells:** {n_cells:,} ({n_pass:,} pass QC, {pct_pass:.1f}%)
""")
```

## Image-level QC

```{python}
#| label: image-metrics
image_path = slide_dir / "image_qc.json"
if image_path.exists():
    with open(image_path) as f:
        image_qc = json.load(f)
    metrics = image_qc.get("metrics", {})
    rows = []
    for k, v in metrics.items():
        if isinstance(v, dict) and "value" in v:
            rows.append({
                "metric": k,
                "value": v.get("value"),
                "status": v.get("status", ""),
            })
    if rows:
        display(pd.DataFrame(rows))
```

```{python}
#| label: image-figures
#| fig-cap: Focus and illumination tile maps
from IPython.display import Image, display
for fig in ["focus_heatmap.png", "illumination_heatmap.png", "drift_dapi_rounds.png"]:
    p = slide_dir / "figures" / fig
    if p.exists():
        display(Image(str(p)))
```

## Marker QC


## Batch QC (cohort)

```{python}
#| label: batch-qc
cohort_path = qc_root / "aggregate" / "cohort_qc.json"
if cohort_path.exists():
    with open(cohort_path) as f:
        cohort = json.load(f)
    display(pd.DataFrame([cohort]))
    status_matrix = qc_root / "aggregate" / "slide_status_matrix.tsv"
    if status_matrix.exists():
        display(pd.read_csv(status_matrix, sep="\t"))
else:
    Markdown("_Cohort QC not available (single-slide mode)._")
```

## MultiQC outputs

```{python}
#| label: multiqc
mqc_dir = slide_dir / "multiqc"
if mqc_dir.exists():
    files = sorted(mqc_dir.glob("*"))
    for f in files:
        print(f.name)
        if f.suffix == ".tsv":
            display(pd.read_csv(f, sep="\t"))
```
